visual_goal: Show Axleby's 2027 topology: stream-aligned journey teams on top consume data products and platforms as services; specialist subsystems sit behind the data products; integration teams meet journey objectives and run on the platform; one enabling team facilitates.
prompt: A three-tier layered illustration of team groups drawn as rounded team cards with small groups of generic people icons. Top tier, left to right: a yellow card labeled 'Enablement', then blue cards labeled 'Dealer journeys', 'Trade and UK' and 'Data API'. Middle tier: an orange card labeled 'Partner integrations' under 'Dealer journeys'; a teal card labeled 'Data products' under 'Data API', with a purple card labeled 'Specialist subsystems' to its right. Bottom tier: one wide green base card labeled 'Platform teams' under 'Dealer journeys', 'Trade and UK' and 'Partner integrations' only. Exactly seven arrows: a solid arrow from 'Dealer journeys' down to 'Platform teams' labeled 'as a service'; a solid arrow from 'Trade and UK' down to 'Platform teams'; a solid arrow from 'Data API' down to 'Data products'; a solid arrow from 'Dealer journeys' diagonally to 'Data products'; a solid arrow from 'Data products' right to 'Specialist subsystems'; a solid arrow from 'Dealer journeys' down to 'Partner integrations' labeled 'journey SLOs'; a solid arrow from 'Partner integrations' down to 'Platform teams'. Plus one dashed arrow from 'Enablement' right into 'Dealer journeys', labeled 'facilitates'. The label 'as a service' sits beside the vertical arrow from 'Dealer journeys' to 'Platform teams'; the label 'journey SLOs' sits beside the short arrow from 'Dealer journeys' to 'Partner integrations'. These are the only words in the image.
alt: Layered team map: dealer journey, trade and UK, and data API teams on top consume data products and platform teams as services; data products use specialist subsystems; partner integrations meet journey SLOs on the platform; an enablement team facilitates.

visual_goal: Show a tier-1 alarm routed by the service catalog to the dependency owner, which deals with the partner, while the journey owner keeps the dealer informed.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with six vertical lanes, each headed by a small icon and a label: an alarm clock labeled 'Sold-but-live job', an index-card box labeled 'Service catalog', a headset labeled 'Integration duty', a group of people labeled 'Adverts team', a generic web-listing screen labeled 'Portal partner', and a small car dealership building labeled 'Dealer'. Horizontal arrows from top to bottom: from 'Sold-but-live job' to 'Service catalog' labeled '30 min live'; from 'Service catalog' to 'Integration duty' labeled 'page owner'; from 'Integration duty' to 'Portal partner' labeled 'escalate'; from 'Integration duty' to 'Adverts team' labeled 'incident note'; from 'Adverts team' to 'Dealer' labeled 'status'; a dashed return arrow from 'Portal partner' back to 'Integration duty' labeled 'listing removed'. These are the only words in the image.
alt: Swimlanes: the sold-but-live job alerts the service catalog, which pages integration duty; integration duty escalates to the portal and notes the adverts team, which updates the dealer; the portal confirms the listing is removed.

visual_goal: Show that most decisions stay with the team after advice, while decisions crossing a boundary go through a decision record, advice and the forum before publication.
prompt: A top-to-bottom decision flow illustration. At the top a rounded box labeled 'Team proposes'. One arrow down into an orange diamond labeled 'Crosses a boundary?'. From the diamond, one arrow to the left labeled 'no' into a green box labeled 'Team decides', and one arrow down from it into a document icon labeled 'Team record'. From the diamond, one arrow to the right labeled 'yes' into a blue document box labeled 'Decision record'; one arrow down from it into a box with speech bubbles labeled 'Advice'; one arrow down into a round-table box labeled 'Forum review'; one arrow down from 'Forum review' labeled 'accepted' into a teal box labeled 'Published record'. One curved arrow from 'Forum review' back up to 'Decision record' labeled 'needs work'. These are the only words in the image.
alt: Decision flow: a team proposal that does not cross a boundary is decided by the team and recorded; one that does becomes a decision record, gathers advice and goes to forum review, which publishes it or sends it back.
